Description: 100 nF X7R ceramic capacitor, 0402, 16 V -- the AC-coupling part for a PCIe transmit pair, small enough that the pair barely notices it.

7-way 1.25 mm side-entry connector standing in for a SATA data receptacle -- same contact count and very nearly the same pitch. Two shell pads, both numbered MP, which is the same shared-pad-number case as a USB receptacle's shield tabs.
A PCIe x1 to 4-port SATA bridge controller, ASM1064 class, in a 48-pin QFN with an exposed pad. See the note at the top of this file about the symbol.
